# olore

> Documentation package manager for AI coding agents. Version-pinned, offline-first docs for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

olore solves AI hallucination of library APIs by providing version-pinned documentation packages that install locally. One command installs curated docs for 70+ libraries. No network required after install. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and any agent supporting the Agent Skills specification.

## Key Links

- [Homepage](https://olore.dev)
- [Registry](https://olore.dev/registry)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/olorehq/olore)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@olorehq/olore)

## How It Works

Install the CLI: `npm install -g @olorehq/olore`
Add docs for a library: `olore install prisma`
Inject reference into project: `olore inject prisma`

Docs are stored locally at ~/.olore/ and symlinked to each agent's skills directory. Agents discover docs automatically via AGENTS.md reference tables.

## vs Context7

| Feature | olore | Context7 |
|---------|-------|----------|
| Network | Offline after install | Required |
| Version | Pinned to exact version | Latest only |
| Setup | One CLI command | MCP server configuration |
| Private docs | Yes | No |
| Context depth | Full documentation | Snippets |
| Agent support | Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode | MCP-compatible agents |

## Available Packages (70+)

nextjs, prisma, drizzle, zod, tailwindcss, clerk, supabase, sentry, playwright, hono, ai-sdk, bun, eslint, tanstack-query, zustand, better-auth, biome, mantine, radix-ui, msw, tanstack-router, tanstack-table, turborepo, vite, remotion, react-three-fiber, cloudflare, expo, storybook, posthog, axiom, neon, convex, hono, langchain, langfuse, and more.
